findings.title: Denial-cache key is ambiguous for valid resource and folder UIDs
findings.body: The key concatenates `name` and `parent` with `_` without escaping or length-prefixing them. Since dashboard/folder UIDs can contain underscores, distinct checks such as name `a_b` in parent `c` and name `a` in parent `b_c` produce the same key. A denial cached for the first resource is consulted before permission evaluation and will incorrectly deny the second resource for the full cache TTL, even when it has a direct or inherited grant. Use an unambiguous structured encoding (or hash/length-prefix each component) for cache-key fields.
